app.tagline: Tsabtace kowane zanen DWG da DXF a cikin babban fayil.
welcome.notice.title: Kafin ka fara
welcome.notice.body: PurgeCAD yana canza zanenku. Manhaja ce ta 'yanci kuma BA TA DA WANI GARANTI KO KAƊAN, gwargwadon abin da doka ta yarda (GNU GPL v3, sassa na 15 da 16). Kana amfani da ita a kan haɗarinka: ajiye kwafin zanenka kuma ka duba sakamakon kafin ka dogara da su.
welcome.notice.accept: Na karanta wannan kuma na yarda
source.dropHint: ko jefa babban fayil a nan
source.empty: Ba a zaɓi babban fayil ba
source.filter.tip: Zane-zane kawai waɗanda sunansu ya ƙunshi ɗaya daga cikin kalmomin. Raba kalmomi da yawa da wakafi; * da ? alamomin maye ne; -kalma tana barin waɗannan sunaye. Manya ko ƙananan haruffa da alamomin lafazi ba su da tasiri.
scan.found: An samu: {dwg} DWG · {dxf} DXF · fayilolin taimako {aux}
scan.none: Ba a samu zane a wannan babban fayil ba.

scan.inaccessible.other: Ba a iya karanta manyan fayiloli {count} ba.
scan.filter.none: Babu zanen da ya dace da matatar.
options.dangerous: Yana cire siffofi, ba ma'anoni da ba a amfani da su kaɗai ba
options.allowUnknown: Tsabtace har da zane-zane masu abubuwan da ACadSharp ba zai iya ajiyewa ba
options.allowUnknown.risk: Mai haɗari: ana cire waɗannan abubuwa (salon gani, ma'aunai masu alaƙa, bayanai daga wasu manhajoji) daga kwafin. Yi amfani da shi don gwaji kawai, kuma ka duba sakamakon a AutoCAD.
engine.auto.name: Kai tsaye
engine.auto.description: AutoCAD idan akwai shi, idan ba haka ba ACadSharp.
engine.autocad.name: AutoCAD
engine.acadsharp.name: ACadSharp
engine.autocad.risk.newerFiles: Ba zai iya buɗe zane-zanen da suka fi AutoCAD da aka girka sabo ba; ana tsallake su.
engine.autocad.risk.windowsOnly: Windows kawai, yana buƙatar cikakken AutoCAD (ba AutoCAD LT ba).
engine.autocad.unavailable.os: Babu shi a wannan tsarin aiki.
engine.autocad.unavailable.notFound: Ba a samu AutoCAD a wannan kwamfuta ba.
engine.acadsharp.risk.rewrite: Yana sake rubuta dukan fayil ɗin da laburaren buɗaɗɗen tushe.
engine.acadsharp.risk.unknownObjects: Abubuwan da bai fahimta ba (abubuwan wakili, bayanai daga wasu manhajoji) za su iya ɓacewa. Ana tsallake irin waɗannan fayiloli ta tsohuwa.
engine.acadsharp.risk.dwg2007: Ba zai iya ajiye fayilolin DWG 2007 ba; ana tsallake su ko a ajiye su a matsayin DWG 2010.
engine.autocad.binaryDxf: Injin AutoCAD ba ya goyon bayan fayilolin DXF na binary.
engine.autocad.fail.noOutput: AutoCAD bai ajiye zanen da aka tsabtace ba.
engine.autocad.fail.license: AutoCAD bai iya fara lasisinsa ba (Unable to initialize adlm). Buɗe AutoCAD sau ɗaya kamar yadda aka saba, sannan sake gwadawa da fayil 1 a lokaci ɗaya.
engine.autocad.fail.stuck: AutoCAD ya daina amsawa (babu fitarwa na mintuna 2), wataƙila yana jiran amsa. Kai linzami kansa don ganin layukan ƙarshe da ya buga.
engine.autocad.fail.cannotOpen: AutoCAD bai iya buɗe wannan fayil ba (ya lalace ko kuma wani shirin da AutoCAD ba ya karɓa ne ya yi shi). Ba a ajiye komai ba; gwada injin ACadSharp.
engine.autocad.risk.categories: Ma'aunan bayani: ana mayar da jerin ma'auni zuwa na tsohuwar AutoCAD; ana kiyaye ma'aunan da ake amfani da su.
output.copy.hint: Ba a taɓa asalin fayiloli ba. Ana kiyaye ƙananan manyan fayiloli.
output.inPlace.hint: Ana fara kwafa kowane asali zuwa _purgecad-backup.
output.reportOnly.hint: Yana nuna abin da za a cire da yawan sararin da za a 'yanta. Ba a ajiye komai ba.
output.replace.hint: Yana rubuta sigar da aka tsabtace a kan kowane asali. Ba a ajiye kwafi ba.
output.replace.confirm.title: A maye gurbin asali?
output.replace.confirm.body: Za a rubuta sigogin da aka tsabtace a kan zane {count}. Ba a ajiye kwafi ba kuma ba za a iya soke wannan ba.
category.RegisteredApps: Manhajojin da aka yi wa rajista

skip.dwg2007: ACadSharp ba zai iya ajiye fayilolin DWG 2007 ba.
fail.timeout: Ya ɗauki lokaci mai tsawo sosai kuma an dakatar da shi.
fail.corrupt: Fayil ɗin ya lalace kuma ba za a iya karanta shi ba.
fail.verify: Sakamakon bai wuce tantancewa ba; an kiyaye asalin.
fail.unexpected: Kuskuren da ba a zata ba.
results.title: Sakamako
results.empty: Zaɓi babban fayil ka danna Fara. Kowane zane zai bayyana a nan tare da sakamakonsa.
summary.estimateNote: Ƙiyasi ne kawai, ba a ajiye komai ba. An rubuta kowane zane a kwafi na wucin gadi da injin da aka zaɓa, an auna shi kuma an goge shi.
cleanup.lock.hint: Sai dai idan ba a buɗe zanen a ko'ina ba.
cleanup.bak.hint: Ajiyar kai tsaye guda ɗaya tilo ta AutoCAD na ajiyewar da ta gabata.
cleanup.permanent: Goge har abada (ba tare da Kwandon Shara ba)
cleanup.alsoDuringPurge: Goge fayilolin taimako ma yayin tsabtacewa
cleanup.confirm.title: A goge waɗannan fayiloli?
cleanup.confirm.body: Fayiloli {count}, {size}. Za su tafi Kwandon Shara.
cleanup.confirm.bodyPermanent: Fayiloli {count}, {size}. Za a goge su har abada.
cleanup.fail: Ba a iya goge fayil ɗin ba.
cleanup.networkNote: Babu Kwandon Shara a faifan cibiyar sadarwa: an matsar da fayilolin zuwa _purgecad-deleted.
cleanup.description: Yana goge fayilolin kulle, ajiya da ajiyewa ta atomatik da aka bari kusa da zane-zane. Ba a taɓa zane-zanen kansu ba.
cloud.note: Shawara: dakatar da daidaitawar Dropbox / OneDrive yayin manyan ayyuka.
about.title: Game da PurgeCAD
update.body.install: Ana girkawa cikin 'yan daƙiƙoƙi; PurgeCAD zai sake farawa. Ana kiyaye saitunanka.
update.body.download: Ba a girka wannan kwafin da mai girkawa ba, don haka ba zai iya sabunta kansa ba. Sauke sabuwar siga daga shafinta.
update.afterRun: Zai kasance idan fayilolin da ake sarrafawa sun gama.
update.failed: Ba a iya girka sabuntawar ba. Sake gwadawa daga baya, ko ka sauke ta daga shafin.
update.unknown: Siga {version}. Ba a iya duba sabuntawa ba (babu intanet?).
update.auto: Duba sabuntawa idan PurgeCAD ya fara
about.noWarranty: Wannan manhaja BA TA DA WANI GARANTI KO KAƊAN. Ajiye kwafin zane-zanenka.
about.autodesk: AutoCAD alamar kasuwanci ce mai rajista ta Autodesk, Inc. PurgeCAD ba shi da alaƙa da Autodesk.
about.value.license: GNU GPL v3 tare da ƙarin sharuɗɗa
engine.autocad.saveVersionTooNew: Wannan AutoCAD ba zai iya adanawa a sigar da aka zaɓa ba (ya tsufa).
engine.acadsharp.saveVersion2007: ACadSharp ba zai iya adana DWG 2007 ba. Zaɓi 2004 ko 2010.
engine.auto.fallback: Idan AutoCAD ya kasa buɗe fayil, ACadSharp zai gwada.
results.engine.fallback.tip: {first} ya kasa sarrafa wannan fayil, don haka {engine} ya yi.
category.MissingReferences.hint: Yana cire xref, hotuna da shimfidun PDF / DWF / DGN waɗanda fayil ɗinsu ba ya nan. AutoCAD kaɗai.
category.MissingReferences.autocadOnly: AutoCAD kaɗai ke cire nassoshin da suka ɓace; ACadSharp yana barin su.
options.what.optInNote: Abubuwan da aka haskaka suna kasancewa a kashe har sai kun yi musu alama.
saveAs.title: Adana a matsayin
saveAs.tip: Adana a wata sigar DWG / DXF. Ya shafi fayilolin da aka yi wa alama: yi wa ɗaya alama don canza shi kaɗai.
profiles.title: Bayanan martaba
profiles.tip: Adana zaɓuɓɓuka da suna kuma sauya da danna ɗaya
profiles.empty: Babu bayanin martaba tukuna. Saita zaɓuɓɓuka, sannan adana su a nan.
profiles.name: Sunan bayanin martaba
profiles.saveHint: Yana adana injin, abin da za a tsaftace, siga, inda za a adana da matatun babban fayil. Suna ɗaya yana maye gurbinsa.
convert.hint: Ba a share komai ba: ana ajiye zane-zanen ne kawai a wannan sigar DWG / DXF. Waɗanda suka riga suna cikinta ba a taɓa su.
convert.engineHint: AutoCAD yana riƙe komai a cikin zanen. ACadSharp ba zai iya rubuta DWG 2007 ba.
about.whatsNew.empty: Ba a iya loda bayanan sakin ba. Kana offline ne?
help.title: Wani abu ya lalace da zane?
help.text: Aiko mana da log ɗin wannan zanen: yana taimaka mana sosai mu gano abin da ya faru. Bayan aiki, danna Nuna log kusa da fayil ɗin, sannan ka haɗa log ɗin lokacin da kake ba da rahoton matsalar.
help.private: Log yana ɗauke da sunayen fayiloli da manyan fayiloli da abin da aka cire, ba zanen kansa ba. Cire duk wani abu na sirri kafin ka aika, kuma kada ka taɓa haɗa zanen abokin ciniki.
help.report.tip: Yana buɗe sabon issue a GitHub tare da sigarka da tsarinka an riga an cika (kana buƙatar asusun GitHub).
support.title: Kyauta kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe, yanzu da har abada
support.share: Hanya mafi kyau ta taimakawa: gaya wa abokan aiki da abokanka game da PurgeCAD, kuma ka ambace shi a dandali, ƙungiyoyi da kafofin sada zumunta. Kowace shawara tana taimaka mana mu ci gaba da gina kayan aiki kyauta ga kowa.
support.money: Kuma idan kana so ka tallafa wa aikinmu kai tsaye, za ka iya yin hakan a
